items.title: Marshall Allen interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 19, 2021
items.q: Because he used to come and talk with Sun Ra you know. He would come up to where we lived and have a conversation with Coltrane.

ctx.x: You just made me get a flash of John Coltrane [scats] and the “Ascension” record? Yeah. And there was no composition except like a lick, and then everybody was like joined in. Were you aware of when that record came out or the late —
Yeah I remember that. Because he used to come and talk with Sun Ra you know. He would come up to where we lived and have a conversation with Coltrane.
And was John Gilmore in on those?
